findings.sourceReading: The first-twilight culprit also executes the second twilight and is then trapped in Natsuhi room. The group seals the room when leaving, preventing the hidden culprit from escaping.
findings.alternative: The culprit did lock the door from inside earlier, so self-locking belongs to the hypothesis. Here, however, the Japanese describes the later confinement caused by the group sealing the room, and English then locked themselves up attributes that step to the culprit.
